clips.title: The story
paras: In Goldshire, Priestess Josetta guides young priests beyond their first trials in Northshire. She teaches faith, devotion, and the work of serving others.

Priestess Josetta tends to the people of Elwynn Forest from an upstairs room in the Lion's Pride Inn. Travelers, guards, and local workers come within her reach there. She offers spiritual care among ordinary folk, showing that service to the Holy Light can be given wherever people need comfort.

Priestess Josetta guides young priests who have finished their first studies at Northshire Abbey. She sends them into the countryside to help wounded guards and comfort those who suffer. Their work teaches them that priesthood asks more than prayers learned by heart. They must put the Light to work and help mend a broken world.

Priestess Josetta regrets that she did not travel farther when she was young. She chose familiar ground over the wider roads of Azeroth. Though she is content with her sacred service in Goldshire, she urges the young disciples who visit her to be bolder and carry their faith to distant frontiers.
